They are two effects of one feature across AL release_core and the inherited shared-drop gate, not two independent defects or a full behavioral counterexample.

negative_missing_payload_free.mutator: In both AN promotion and inherited public_shared free_recovered paths, uses Ghost::<physical_projection::FreeReceipt>::conjure() instead of physical_projection::deallocate(...). This is a proof-model mutation; it does not itself establish that a concrete native deallocation was skipped.
negative_missing_payload_free.classification: The printed payload task is a Shared.ref_cnt Atomic invariant obligation under this proof-model substitution; it is not a direct counterfeit-receipt theorem. Two paired targets expose the same feature, not independent defects.

negative_missing_control_free.mutator: In both paired free_recovered targets, uses Ghost::<free_effect::TypedFreeReceipt<Shared>>::conjure() instead of free_effect::deallocate_typed_box(...); it modifies only the proof input/control.
